title: Deformity Analysis
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Start from a standing long leg film with the positioning conditions met.
Measure the femoral and tibial contributions separately against their own joint orientation references.
Assess the joint line separately from the bones above and below it.
Assess the sagittal plane on the lateral film, because a flexion deformity is part of the analysis.
Compare with the other limb, since a bilateral pattern suggests constitutional rather than acquired deformity.
